invariants.rationale: file is dereferenced at file.parent(), so it must be non-null.
path is passed to StringTokenizer, which requires a non-null String.
result is updated via .parent() or .child(), neither of which should return null.
result is assigned from file.parent() and result.child(), each returning a FileHandle.
result.path() is a string representing the relative path: possibly empty but always non-null.
